utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Good morning everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-74-T, the Prosecutor versus Prlic et al. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. Today we are Tuesday. I'd like to welcome all the people in the courtroom, Prosecution, Defence counsel, the accused. I was told that Mr. Pusic was taken ill and cannot be in the courtroom today. I would like to give the floor to the registrar that he give us an IC number, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. The OTP has submitted its response to 3D and 4D's request for admission of exhibits tendered for Husnija Mahmutovic. This response shall be given Exhibit Number IC 764. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. We shall now move into closed session. I'd like the blinds to be dropped, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 9th day of January, 2008, at 9.00 a.m. 18 19 20 21 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.46 p.m.,
